text:
maya: ACME flagged SSO for MVP — they say it's blocking their pilot next month. Need a decision: push timeline or cut other scope?
jon: Do we have a minimal SSO surface we can ship? token-based preview vs full SAML?
tara: We only have an OAuth quickpath prototyped. Full SAML will add ~3 sprints of dev + infra.
alex: If we pull SSO into MVP, we should defer embeddings cache + batching perf work.
maya: Proposal: shrinkwrap the MVP — include OAuth SSO only + schedule a single enterprise SAML adapter for v1. Phased handoff to infra later.
jon: How does that affect latency/SLAs? OAuth path is straightforward; SAML touches onboarding and cert mgmt.
tara: Risk: customer audit logs and mapping required for compliance. That might still block the pilot even with OAuth.
product-bot: Reminder: launch-criteria checklist -> https://redwood.internal/launch/checklist
maya: Ok alternate: two-phased milestone: MVP-alpha (pilot) with OAuth SSO + manual onboarding; MVP-beta (automated SAML) in ~4 weeks. Buys urgency, limits dev scope.
jon: Manual onboarding = runbook + support ops. Low dev cost, higher ops effort. Ops ok with that?
alex: Ops confirmed: can do manual onboarding for up to 3 customers for 4 weeks, after which we must automate.
tara: If we accept manual onboarding, we still need minimal audit logs. I can own a logging shim — estimate 3 days.
maya: Decision leaning: agree to phased milestone. I'll update milestone board and move batching + cache to v1.1. @product-bot please tag thread "manual-onboard". :white_check_mark:
product-bot: Milestone board updated: MVP-alpha target 2024-06-05. Removed items: embeddings-cache, batching-squeeze. Added tag: manual-onboard. (automated note)
